title: 운영 / 수집
description: 수집 파이프라인(crawler·monitoring) 회귀 감지 - 09-02 인스타 로그아웃 프로필 401로 COLLECT가 3일간 사실상 100% 실패했는데 DB에 실패가 안 남고 알람도 없어 09-04에야 발견한 사고 재발 감지용. 알람 룰 그룹 hypenow-collection과 같은 판정식(어제 값 vs 7일 중앙값)을 대시보드로도 본다.

panels.title: 어제 raw_profile / 7일 중앙값 비율
panels.description: crawler 프로필 수집 전체 건수 회귀 지표. 어제(KST) 값 / 직전 7일(2일 전~8일 전) 중앙값. 상향 스파이크는 알람 대상이 아니라 회귀만 본다. 09-02 로그아웃 프로필 401 사고를 이 지표로 잡는다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT (captured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AS day, count(*) c
  FROM raw_profile
  WHERE captured_at >= now() - interval '9 days'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  coalesce((SELECT c FROM d WHERE day = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1), 0)::float
  / NULLIF((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c) FROM d WHERE day BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 8 AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 2), 0)
  AS value

panels.title: 어제 REELS 런 비율
panels.description: crawler REELS 잡(crawl_run) 일 실행 건수 회귀 지표. 어제(KST) 값 / 직전 7일(2일 전~8일 전) 중앙값. 상향 스파이크는 알람 대상이 아니라 회귀만 본다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT (started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AS day, count(*) c
  FROM crawl_run
  WHERE job = 'REELS' AND started_at >= now() - interval '9 days'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  coalesce((SELECT c FROM d WHERE day = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1), 0)::float
  / NULLIF((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c) FROM d WHERE day BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 8 AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 2), 0)
  AS value

panels.title: 어제 Hiker 콜 비율
panels.description: monitoring raw.fetch_payload(Hiker 실 콜 로그) 일 건수 회귀 지표. 어제(KST) 값 / 직전 7일(2일 전~8일 전) 중앙값. 상향 스파이크는 알람 대상이 아니라 회귀만 본다. 등록 폭증·백필로 절대값 변동이 커서 비율로 본다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT (fetched_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AS day, count(*) c
  FROM raw.fetch_payload
  WHERE fetched_at >= now() - interval '9 days'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  coalesce((SELECT c FROM d WHERE day = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1), 0)::float
  / NULLIF((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c) FROM d WHERE day BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 8 AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 2), 0)
  AS value

panels.title: 어제 태그 게시물 발견 비율
panels.description: brand_tagged_post 신규 발견(first_seen_at) 일 건수 회귀 지표. 어제(KST) 값 / 직전 7일(2일 전~8일 전) 중앙값. 상향 스파이크는 알람 대상이 아니라 회귀만 본다. 태그 스캔이 멈추면 여기가 먼저 무너진다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT (first_seen_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AS day, count(*) c
  FROM brand_tagged_post
  WHERE first_seen_at >= now() - interval '9 days'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  coalesce((SELECT c FROM d WHERE day = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1), 0)::float
  / NULLIF((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c) FROM d WHERE day BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 8 AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 2), 0)
  AS value

panels.title: 어제 self 스윕 ok 비율
panels.description: self 백엔드로 성공(outcome=ok)한 fetchPost·fetchComments 최근 26시간 합계 / 최근 7일 평균(하루치로 환산). self가 로그아웃 401 등으로 막히면 hiker로 폴백돼 self ok는 떨어진다.

panels.title: 마지막 sweep_run
panels.description: monitoring 일일 스윕(성공 기준, sweep_run.ok) 마지막 시작으로부터 경과 시간. 스윕은 하루 1회(02:00 KST경)라 26시간을 넘기면 어젯밤 스윕이 안 돈 것이다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch from now()-max(started_at)) AS value FROM sweep_run WHERE ok

panels.title: 회귀 표 - crawler
panels.description: 지표별 어제(KST) 값 · 직전 7일(2~8일 전) 중앙값 · 비율. row1의 요약을 지표 단위로 펼친 것. raw_profile은 전체·SELF_GQL·HIKER_MOBILE 소스별, crawl_run은 REELS 런·COLLECT 성공 런.

targets.rawSql:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT '1_전체 raw_profile' m, (captured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date d, count(*) c
    FROM raw_profile WHERE captured_at >= now() - interval '9 days' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2_SELF_GQL raw_profile', (captured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, count(*)
    FROM raw_profile WHERE source='SELF_GQL' AND captured_at >= now() - interval '9 days' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '3_HIKER_MOBILE raw_profile', (captured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, count(*)
    FROM raw_profile WHERE source='HIKER_MOBILE' AND captured_at >= now() - interval '9 days' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '4_REELS 런', (started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, count(*)
    FROM crawl_run WHERE job='REELS' AND started_at >= now() - interval '9 days' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '5_COLLECT SUCCEEDED 런', (started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, count(*)
    FROM crawl_run WHERE job='COLLECT' AND status='SUCCEEDED' AND started_at >= now() - interval '9 days' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '6_raw_media_page', (captured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, count(*)
    FROM raw_media_page WHERE captured_at >= now() - interval '9 days' GROUP BY 2
)
SELECT
  right(m, length(m)-2) AS "지표",
  coalesce(sum(c) FILTER (WHERE d = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1), 0) AS "어제",
  round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c) FILTER (WHERE d BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 8 AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 2))::numeric, 1) AS "7일 중앙값",
  round(
    coalesce(sum(c) FILTER (WHERE d = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1), 0)::numeric
    / NULLIF((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c) FILTER (WHERE d BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 8 AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 2))::numeric, 0)
  , 2) AS "비율"
FROM raw
GROUP BY m
ORDER BY m

panels.title: 회귀 표 - monitoring
panels.description: 지표별 어제(KST) 값 · 직전 7일(2~8일 전) 중앙값 · 비율. row1의 요약을 지표 단위로 펼친 것. fetch_payload은 Hiker 콜 전체 합계, 태그 게시물은 발견(first_seen_at)·보강(enriched_at), author_profile은 조회(fetched_at) 건수.

targets.rawSql:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT '1_fetch_payload 합계' m, (fetched_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date d, count(*) c
    FROM raw.fetch_payload WHERE fetched_at >= now() - interval '9 days' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2_태그 게시물 발견', (first_seen_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, count(*)
    FROM brand_tagged_post WHERE first_seen_at >= now() - interval '9 days' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '3_태그 게시물 보강', (enriched_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, count(*)
    FROM brand_tagged_post WHERE enriched_at >= now() - interval '9 days' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '4_author_profile 조회', (fetched_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, count(*)
    FROM author_profile WHERE fetched_at >= now() - interval '9 days' GROUP BY 2
)
SELECT
  right(m, length(m)-2) AS "지표",
  coalesce(sum(c) FILTER (WHERE d = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1), 0) AS "어제",
  round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c) FILTER (WHERE d BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 8 AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 2))::numeric, 1) AS "7일 중앙값",
  round(
    coalesce(sum(c) FILTER (WHERE d = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1), 0)::numeric
    / NULLIF((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c) FILTER (WHERE d BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 8 AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 2))::numeric, 0)
  , 2) AS "비율"
FROM raw
GROUP BY m
ORDER BY m

panels.title: raw_profile 일건수 by source
panels.description: crawler 프로필 수집 일별 건수, 소스별 누적 막대. 09-02 사고처럼 SELF_GQL이 꺼지면 여기서 색이 바뀐다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', captured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
  count(*) AS "건수",
  source
FROM raw_profile
WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_at)
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: crawl_run 일 런수 by job
panels.description: 잡 종류별 일일 실행 건수(모든 상태 포함). 실패만 보려면 옆 패널.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
  count(*) AS "런수",
  job
FROM crawl_run
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 실패 런 by job
panels.description: status='FAILED'인 crawl_run만 집계. 평시 0에 가깝다 - 튀면 해당 잡부터 원인 확인.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
  count(*) AS "실패",
  job
FROM crawl_run
WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: request_count 일 합계 by actor_id
panels.description: crawl_run.request_count(외부 콜 수) 합계를 actor_id(수집 방식)별로. Apify 등 유료 콜 추정치.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
  sum(request_count) AS "요청수",
  coalesce(actor_id, '(없음)') AS actor_id
FROM crawl_run
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: fetch_payload 일 콜 by kind
panels.description: monitoring이 실제로 쏜 Hiker 콜(raw.fetch_payload) 일별 건수, kind별 누적 막대.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', fetched_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
  count(*) AS "콜수",
  kind
FROM raw.fetch_payload
WHERE $__timeFilter(fetched_at)
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: http_status != 200 일건수
panels.description: Hiker 응답 중 200이 아닌 건수. 평시 0 - 늘면 Hiker 쪽 요율제한·인증 문제 의심.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', fetched_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
  count(*) AS "오류건수"
FROM raw.fetch_payload
WHERE http_status IS DISTINCT FROM 200 AND $__timeFilter(fetched_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 일 콜 비용 추정
panels.description: Hiker 콜 건수 × $0.693/1,000콜 근사 단가. 실제 청구와는 오차가 있을 수 있다 - 정확한 잔액은 아래 벤더 잔액 패널.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', fetched_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
  count(*) * 0.693 / 1000 AS "비용"
FROM raw.fetch_payload
WHERE $__timeFilter(fetched_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: self 콜 by path (1일)
panels.description: self(직접 크롤) 백엔드로 나간 콜을 path별 1일 증가량으로. instagram_source_route_total 카운터 기반.

panels.title: self vs hiker 폴백 비율
panels.description: self 성공(ok) / (self 성공 + self 실패로 hiker에 넘어간 콜) - self 실패는 backend=hiker,outcome=fallback:*로 찍힌다(self 라벨엔 안 남는다). 09-02 사고처럼 self가 막히면 이 비율이 떨어진다.

panels.title: self GB/일 추정
panels.description: 콜당 embed 125KB(fetchPost)·댓글 160KB(fetchComments) 환산 근사치 - 실측 사용량은 아래 벤더 잔액·소비 패널(DataImpulse) 참고.

panels.title: self partial 비율

panels.title: likes null 비율
panels.description: post_snapshot·brand_post_snapshot 일별 likes 결측 비율 - likes_hidden(비공개 설정)으로 인한 결측은 제외하고 순수 수집 실패만 본다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (captured_on::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
  avg((likes IS NULL AND NOT likes_hidden)::int) AS "비율",
  'post_snapshot' AS "구분"
FROM post_snapshot
WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_on)
GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
  (captured_on::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
  avg((likes IS NULL AND NOT likes_hidden)::int) AS "비율",
  'brand_post_snapshot' AS "구분"
FROM brand_post_snapshot
WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_on)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: comments null 비율
panels.description: post_snapshot·brand_post_snapshot 일별 comments 결측 비율(captured_on 기준).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (captured_on::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
  avg((comments IS NULL)::int) AS "비율",
  'post_snapshot' AS "구분"
FROM post_snapshot
WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_on)
GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
  (captured_on::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
  avg((comments IS NULL)::int) AS "비율",
  'brand_post_snapshot' AS "구분"
FROM brand_post_snapshot
WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_on)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 어제 likes null 비율
panels.description: post_snapshot + brand_post_snapshot 합산, 어제(KST) likes 결측 비율(likes_hidden 제외).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg((likes IS NULL AND NOT likes_hidden)::int) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT likes, likes_hidden FROM post_snapshot WHERE captured_on = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1
  UNION ALL
